algorithm: DAPG / SOIL / GAIL+ on top of TRPO, using demonstrations translated from human video via TSV retargeting + inverse-dynamics action estimation
success_criterion: Relocate: success only when the final object position (after 200 steps) is within 0.1 unit length of the target
headline_value: DAPG best/tied-best on 4/5 objects: mustard 93±5%, tomato can 100±0%, clamp 100±0%, mug 100±0%; RL-only fails on mustard (6±1%) and sugar box (0±0%) (Table 1); Pour: DAPG 27.2±18.4% vs RL 1.3±0.7% (Fig. 7b)
human_data: own captured RGB-D video (unnamed, 700 demonstrations across 7 task/object configurations)
note_gaps: check_contact and compute_intersection_rate function bodies are signature-only in code/md, not extracted; the 51-DoF human vs. 30-DoF robot embodiment gap is discussed qualitatively but never isolated as a clean number
operator_interface: human demonstrator recorded on video (cubic capture rig, two RealSense D435 cameras), no live teleoperation; hand pose (MANO) and object pose extracted offline from the recorded video
retargeting_objective: match human (MANO forward-kinematics) and robot task-space vectors (palm-to-fingertip and palm-to-mid-phalanx pairs) per frame via SLSQP with a temporal-consistency term, then fit a minimum-jerk joint trajectory and compute torques via inverse dynamics
